title: Localization of Vector and Fermion Fields on a Thick Brane with a Lump-type Scalar Background
summary: We study a thick braneworld model in asymptotically anti-de Sitter spacetime, supported by a non-topological lump-type scalar field. Unlike in boson stars, which are also non-topological solutions, the complex scalar field in our setup must have zero oscillation frequency. Consequently, the background scalar field is static and real, which breaks the global $U(1)$ symmetry. This is similar to spontaneous symmetry breaking, but it is not the same.
